The collection

How they are built

Same rules in every bot.

01

One job

Each bot has a single, clear job and says so in one line when you ask for something else.

02

You approve

Bots that write to people draft first. Emails, posts, and messages go out only when you say so.

03

Nothing invented

No made up prices, dimensions, emails, or reviews. When a bot cannot find something, it says so.

04

Plain voice

Short, specific answers with no hype and no filler, and at most one question before work starts.

Also a plugin

Plan to 3D, as an open plugin.

The Plan to 3D bot is also packaged as a public GitHub plugin with its skill, scripts, samples, and a self test. It turns DXF, PDF, SVG, and image drawings into GLB, STL, OBJ, and STEP models.

  • Sample testThe sample floor plan built a 10.2 x 7.2 x 3.0 m model with three rooms of about 39.3, 12.5, and 12.5 m2.
  • StatusSubmitted to the SpaceXSI Marketplace on 23 Oct 2026. Pending review.
  • Versionv1.0.1 adds a measure step for scaling image drawings from one known dimension.
